method: English Wikipedia opening sentence, via the MediaWiki API and that site's redirects from the catalogue name. The writer-list dates field was not used. If this pass could not tie a name to one page with a life span in the opening, that person stays undated and is not placed on the spiral. A second read on 2026-11-08 replaced three namesake pages (Theodor Bergmann, Peter Petroff, Mark Starr). Alexander Lozovsky stays undated: the page reached from that name is a Soviet general (1907–1981), and the page for Solomon Lozovsky does not identify him as Alexander.
